{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders identified: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[~df.index.isin(qa_orders.index)]

# Check: are there any 'refunded' orders?
refunded_count = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]
print(f"Number of refunded orders in cleaned data: {refunded_count}")

# Filter for completed orders from LOYAL customers
df_loyal_completed = df_clean[(df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df_clean['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute mean revenue
total_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].sum()
num_orders = df_loyal_completed.shape[0]
mean_revenue = total_revenue / num_orders

print(f"Number of LOYAL completed orders: {num_orders}")
print(f"Mean revenue: {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
